text:
Maya Chen: Quick ask — need a one-sheeter that maps inbound lead lanes for the upcoming webinar + bench launch. Think: webinar signup → demo request → sales nurture. Should include conversion benchmarks, CTA flows, and creative specs for each lane. Deadline: Tue EOD (48hrs).
Cassie Rivera: @Maya Chen got it — do you want separate art tiles per lane or one combined infographic?
Maya Chen: Separate tiles + a combined one-pager. Make them Figma-ready and include export guidelines (sizes, safe zones). :thumbsup:
Sam Patel: Can you add recommended copy lengths for hero vs email subject? Also need tokenized metrics: CTR, CVR, demo rate — approximations okay.
Jordan Kim: Brand check — we need accessible color variants and non-photo backgrounds for dark-mode emails. Also include approved alt text examples for each tile.
Cassie Rivera: Noted. Any mandated fonts/logos or lockups to use? I'll pull from the brand kit.
Ana Torres: Dropping copy + rough numbers here: https://docs.google.com/.../inbound-lane-copy (private). Hero CTA short: "Try Redwood" (12–15 chars). Demo CTA: "Request demo". Subject line suggestions included in the doc.
Lee Rivera: Timeline works for me. Cassie, can you estimate hours? Prefer Figma file by tomorrow noon so content can review before design->legal.
Cassie Rivera: Estimate 4–6 hrs. Will aim for a morning drop and post the Figma link in this thread.
Maya Chen: Also include a tiny 2‑step flow graphic showing how caching/batching impacts cost-per-token — marketing will annotate copy.
Sam Patel: For benchmarks, use these baseline numbers: signup→nurture CTR 18%, demo request 2.4%, SQL 0.6%. Flag anything that looks off.
brand-bot: Reminder: use latest logos from /brand/assets/2025/q4 and the new lockup spacing. Run through brand compliance checklist.
Cassie Rivera: WIP export specs I'll include in the Figma file. Quick snippet here:
```
Export specs:
- hero tile: 1200x628 px (png @2x)
- one-sheet: A4 PDF (vector)
- icons: svg + 48px png fallback
- accessible color swatches: tokenized CSS vars
```
Maya Chen: Perfect. After design drop I'll route to legal for a quick brand compliance sweep. :eyes:
Sam Patel: Thumbs up from growth.
Jordan Kim: Tagging design-ops for accessibility spot-check.
Maya Chen: Thanks all — will consolidate feedback and send final checklist after review.
